title: Want a gold star for brushing your teeth? Get this app
body: I've never written a review for an app before but i love this app SO much and i want everyone in the world to know about it. It's so versatile and you can make it work for you, whatever you need. One of my favorite features is the "goals," where you can set a goal for how many times a day you do the thing, and there's no penalty or annoying reminder to do the goal, but when you check it off it gives you a big pop up with confetti and it gives me ALL the dopamine. If you are the type of person who would genuinely benefit from getting a gold star for every task you accomplish (like i am) this is the app for you!!

title: Good But Dark Mode Behind A Paywall
body:
The app isn't fantastic but the free version does most of what I want it to do and it's aesthetically pleasing. My issue is that I have to shell out $13 for premium just for dark mode. Dark mode is an important accessibility feature and it's unacceptable for it to be behind a paywall. Leaving this review to ask the devs to reconsider that decision. 

edit: Downgrading my review from four to two stars four months later because dark mode is still behind a paywall. I have frequent photosensitivity and I cannot use the app at night because the devs apparently don't give two shakes of a rat's tail about accessibility.

title: Perfect!!
body:
What a wonderful habit tracker app. Simple, but super flexible and thoughtfully designed. Great data visualizations too! Loved it so much, I upgraded to the premium version.

Two requests for the devs:
1. Can you add the ability to choose percentages *or* fractions for the list of habits shown on each day? Eg. 2/3 would indicate I have completed 2 of my weekly goal of 3. That’s way easier to parse than 66%.

2. It would be cool to track habits I want to quit. Say I only want to eat junk food twice per week. My streak would only continue if I complete the habit two or FEWER times in a week. Going over my target ends the streak.
author: AAAAAA9AAAAAAAA!

title: Very Useful
body:
I just completed one month using this app and I have found it to be very easy to use and encouraging when you can see the progress made over the course of a month. 
Paying for Premium is a definite must have - ads are extremely bothersome without it. 

Highly recommended app for a simple way to make new habits and be able to see areas that need more work. 
Time stamp is a nice feature as well as the note feature and you can actually go back and check off a previous day if you forgot to. 

It’s very helpful for the person who is a more visual person, and for those who want to learn to be more intentional about their use of their days.

title: Simple and great!
body:
I've tried 10 habit tracking apps at this point, including most of the ones with 1k reviews. I think this one actually wins in for the insightful data content where the charts are actually practical and useful and not just there to look cool. Compared to other apps, it's ridiculously easy to add data for previous dates. 

The color options were really advanced to my surprise. 

And my favorite aspect of this app compared to others is the memo adding feature where compared to other apps, you can see them logged as you scroll through the calendar view (rather than your standard list view). 

I actually think this app was very thoughtfully designed with the right amount of customization and perfect amount of content hierarchy.
